description: Where the build reads source from, and where it writes. The React application's source root used to be written into three build files -- vite.config.ts as its root and outDir, _build_chain.py as the dist it stages, hf_helpers.py as the dist it inlines fonts into -- all spelling Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/frontend. Moving the application, which is what refactoring the business layout does, broke the build in three places. The build was depending on the business architecture. dist is under build/ and not beside the source: a build that writes into the business tree leaves derived bytes among authored ones, and the first draft of this file had vite emitting into Website/FindCareChat/dist.
